extra.question: Is there any card from Erica Yang artist in pauper format and available in paper? If so, indicate its ID.
extra.evidence: available in paper refers to availability = 'paper'
extra.question_with_evidence: Is there any card from Erica Yang artist in pauper format and available in paper? If so, indicate its ID. Hint: available in paper refers to availability = 'paper'
extra.SQL: SELECT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Erica Yang' AND T2.format = 'pauper' AND T1.availability = 'paper'
